EntadFramework.EntadTraitDef.label: Persona
EntadFramework.EntadTraitDef.description: An intelligent persona lives in this weapon. It usually bonds with its first wielder and refuses anyone else, and the two fight with a speed and precision neither could manage alone.

EntadFramework.EntadTraitDef.label: Freewielder
EntadFramework.EntadTraitDef.description: This weapon's persona doesn't form bonds. Anyone can pick it up and use it.

EntadFramework.EntadTraitDef.label: Secretive
EntadFramework.EntadTraitDef.description: This weapon's persona won't say what it can do. Its other traits stay hidden until they show themselves in use.

EntadFramework.EntadTraitDef.label: Kind Whispers
EntadFramework.EntadTraitDef.description: The persona is kind and supportive, and whispers encouragement to whoever it's bonded with.

li.label: {WEAPON}'s kind whispers
li.description: {WEAPON}, my bonded weapon, keeps whispering kind things to me.

EntadFramework.EntadTraitDef.label: Mad Muttering
EntadFramework.EntadTraitDef.description: The persona is neurotic and never stops muttering to whoever it's bonded with.

li.label: {WEAPON}'s muttering
li.description: {WEAPON}, my bonded weapon, mutters in my head. It's hard to ignore.

EntadFramework.EntadTraitDef.label: Gluttonous
EntadFramework.EntadTraitDef.description: The persona loves food and passes its appetite on: whoever it's bonded with gets hungry 50% faster.

HediffDef.label: persona hunger
HediffDef.description: Hunger is increased by the psychic influence of a bonded weapon.

EntadFramework.EntadTraitDef.label: Jealous
EntadFramework.EntadTraitDef.description: The persona flies into a rage when the person bonded to it uses another weapon.

li.label: {WEAPON}'s jealousy
li.description: My bonded weapon {WEAPON} is jealous that I'm using another weapon. I can feel it screaming into my head.

EntadFramework.EntadTraitDef.label: Kill Thirst
EntadFramework.EntadTraitDef.description: The persona finds purpose in bloodshed. After 20 days without a kill it grows angry and complains to whoever is bonded with it.

li.label: {WEAPON}'s kill thirst
li.description: My bonded weapon {WEAPON} is angry it has gone so long without killing. I can feel its rage.
